svg.title: Coastguard officer — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as coastguard officer, wearing a rescue jacket and a rescue helmet. Visible work cue: A four-section life ring has a visible central opening and a trailing rescue rope. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a rescue helmet.
